Method new()

create a new single object

Usage

persephoneSingle$new(
  ts,
  template = "rsa3",
  context = NULL,
  userdefined = NULL,
  speclist = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

ts

a time series object

template

passed as the spec argument of rjd3x13::x13_fast() or rjd3tramoseats::tramoseats_fast()

context

passed as the context argument of rjd3x13::x13_fast() or rjd3tramoseats::tramoseats_fast(), a list of external regressors (calendar or other) to be used for estimation

userdefined

passed as the userdefined argument of rjd3x13::x13_fast() or rjd3tramoseats::tramoseats_fast()

speclist

a list of additional arguments for customizing the model specifications, passed to the rjd3 specification functions internally. As alternative input to ....

...

passed to rjd3x13::x13_spec() or rjd3tramoseats::tramoseats_spec() if no speclist parameter is set.
